transcript: Speaker A: Priya, 6 LPA placement vachilo agipoyindi ra. Nee English speaking chala weak ga undi, mundu dhanni improve chesukomannaru. [Priya, I missed a 6 LPA placement because my English is weak and they told me to improve it.] Speaker B: Arey, ila tadabadutu English matladite reject kakunda inke emavtav? Naku correct time ki SpeakX app dorikindi. Ee app lo AI English teacher untundi. Nuvvu kevalam 10-15 nimishalu kaitayiste chalu. Mock interviews ki prepare avvachu, basics nunchi nerpistundi. Grammar correct chestundi, vocabulary suggest chestundi. 15-20 rojullo confidence perigipotundi. [If you hesitate, you'll get rejected. I found SpeakX app. It has an AI English teacher. Spend 10-15 minutes daily to prepare for mock interviews from basics. It corrects grammar and suggests vocabulary, boosting confidence in 15-20 days.] Speaker A: Super ra, nenu ipude download chestanu. [Super, I will download it right now.]
on_screen_text: Priya, 6 LPA placement aagipoyindi ra... [Priya, 6 LPA placement missed...] SpeakX app [SpeakX app] Download SpeakX App, Start 7 Days Trial Now [Download SpeakX App, Start 7 Days Trial Now]
summary: A young man shares his disappointment over losing a job placement due to poor English. His friend introduces him to the SpeakX app, highlighting its AI teacher, mock interview prep, and grammar correction features. The ad concludes with a call to download the app for a 7-day trial.
